title: The Dog Night, 2006
arc: The Dog Night · inside the parody week
logline: Seven years. The Dog Night falls inside the parody week. The Drift Wood daily that day: a stick figure asleep beside a properly drawn dog. The one honest panel of the week.

margin.note: No mark — the parody week is unsigned, and this ran in the parody's slot.

panels.composition: The garage, drawn in the strip's real style. Under the drafting table: BARNABY, properly drawn, asleep in the bed. Beside him on the floor: the stick figure with the rotor, also asleep, crude.

characters.pose: asleep in the bed, properly drawn
asleep on the floor beside him, crude

image.prompt: a garage studio drawn carefully in ink and muddy color, a gray-muzzled dog properly drawn asleep in a braided bed under a drafting table, and beside it on the floor a crude ballpoint stick figure with a helicopter rotor also asleep, the two styles side by side, no words
image.notes: Two styles, one panel. The dog real, the meme crude. The only honest panel of the week.

panels.composition: The dog's face. Real. Gray. Breathing.

image.prompt: close-up of a carefully drawn gray-muzzled sleeping dog's face, ink and soft color, no words

panels.composition: The stick figure's face. Two dots and a line. The rotor still.

image.prompt: close-up of a crude stick figure's face: two dots and a line, a still rotor scribbled above, no words

panels.composition: The room. Both asleep. The monitor at the back showing a counter with five digits. Nobody behind the dumpster tonight. The first Dog Night not at the dumpster.

image.prompt: a dark garage with a dog and a stick figure asleep on the floor and a monitor glowing at the back with a five-digit counter, no words
image.notes: The first Dog Night not at the dumpster. The counter: five digits. Letter after.

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The Dog Night inside the parody week. The dog drawn right; the meme drawn wrong; the counter at five digits.
